Name: Artificer
Description: Makers of magic-infused objects who treat magic as a complex system to be decoded, engineered, and unleashed.
Character Creation Implications: Hit Die: d8. Grants Magical Tinkering, Artificer spellcasting, and the Infuse Item ability to temporarily turn mundane items into magical gear. Subclass chosen at level 3.

Name: Barbarian
Description: Fierce warriors powered by primal forces that manifest as a relentless rage, relying on immense physical might and durability.
Character Creation Implications: Hit Die: d12. Saves: Strength & Constitution. Grants Rage (damage resistance and bonus damage), Unarmored Defense, and Weapon Mastery. Subclass chosen at level 3.

Name: Bard
Description: Inspiring performers who weave music, dance, and magic into powerful supportive abilities, illusions, and utility.
Character Creation Implications: Hit Die: d8. Saves: Dexterity & Charisma. Grants Bardic Inspiration, comprehensive spellcasting, and Jack of All Trades. Subclass chosen at level 3.

Name: Blood Hunter
Description: Hunters of monsters who undergo mutations and use hemocraft (blood magic) to combat the dark horrors that plague the land.
Character Creation Implications: Grants a Hemocraft die used to augment abilities at the cost of hit points, Blood Maledict (blood curses), and Crimson Rite (elemental weapon damage). Subclass (Order) chosen at level 3.

Name: Cleric
Description: Miraculous priests who act as conduits for divine magic from the Outer Planes, balancing durable combat with potent healing.
Character Creation Implications: Hit Die: d8. Saves: Wisdom & Charisma. Grants spellcasting, a Divine Order choice (armor/weapons vs. cantrips), and Channel Divinity. Subclass chosen at level 3.

Name: Druid
Description: Priests of primal power who harness the forces of nature to shape-shift into animals, control terrain, and summon elemental fury.
Character Creation Implications: Hit Die: d8. Saves: Intelligence & Wisdom. Grants a Primal Order choice (armor vs. cantrips), spellcasting, and Wild Shape. Subclass chosen at level 3.

Name: Fighter
Description: Unparalleled masters of martial combat, armor, and weaponry, boasting high versatility and survivability on the battlefield.
Character Creation Implications: Hit Die: d10. Saves: Strength & Constitution. Grants Weapon Mastery, Second Wind (healing/utility), a Fighting Style feat, and Action Surge. Subclass chosen at level 3.

Name: Gunslinger
Description: A definitive take on a martial combatant specializing in the use of firearms.
Character Creation Implications: Serves as a backline striker. Designed to fit the flexible face, scout, or sneak dynamic.

Name: Illrigger
Description: An unholy herald of the powers of Hell that operates as the evil antithesis of the paladin.
Character Creation Implications: Serves as a hellish anti-paladin. Subclasses alter their infernal focus and fighting style.

Name: Magus
Description: A martial and magical hybrid class that blends swordplay with arcane spellcasting.
Character Creation Implications: Subclasses offer varied disciplines, such as Arcane Order (knowledge seekers), Heaven's Guard (protectors/healers), and Knights Stygian.

Name: Monk
Description: Martial artists of supernatural focus who channel internal energy into extraordinary agility and rapid, unarmored strikes.
Character Creation Implications: Hit Die: d8. Saves: Strength & Dexterity. Grants Martial Arts (unarmed scaling), Unarmored Defense, and Focus Points to fuel Flurry of Blows and Patient Defense. Subclass chosen at level 3.

Name: Paladin
Description: Devout warriors united by sacred oaths, blending frontline martial prowess with divine smites and defensive auras.
Character Creation Implications: Hit Die: d10. Saves: Wisdom & Charisma. Grants Lay on Hands (healing pool), Weapon Mastery, Divine Smite, and half-caster spell progression. Subclass chosen at level 3.

Name: Pugilist
Source: Sterling Vermin Adventure Co. / Benjamin Huffman
Description: Powerful martial warriors who rely on unarmed strikes and improvised weapons to grapple and batter foes into submission.
Character Creation Implications: Highly resilient against saving throws. Trades the monk's ki for Moxie. Subclasses include Piss and Vinegar, Squared Circle, Street Saint, and Sweet Science.

Name: Ranger
Description: Wandering warriors imbued with primal magic, expertly navigating the wilds to hunt down monsters and protect the world.
Character Creation Implications: Hit Die: d10. Saves: Strength & Dexterity. Grants Weapon Mastery, spellcasting, free uses of Hunter's Mark, and Deft Explorer expertise. Subclass chosen at level 3.

Name: Rogue
Description: Dexterous experts in stealth, skill, and subterfuge who exploit enemy weaknesses for devastating precision strikes.
Character Creation Implications: Hit Die: d8. Saves: Dexterity & Intelligence. Grants Sneak Attack (bonus damage on advantageous strikes), Skill Expertise, and Cunning Action. Subclass chosen at level 3.

Name: Sorcerer
Description: Dazzling mages who channel the raw, roiling power of innate magic stamped into their very bloodlines and being.
Character Creation Implications: Hit Die: d6. Saves: Constitution & Charisma. Grants Innate Sorcery (temporary spellcasting buffs), spellcasting, and Font of Magic (Sorcery Points for Metamagic). Subclass chosen at level 3.

Name: Talent
Description: A psionic class capable of manipulating time, reality, and physical forms through intense mental prowess.
Character Creation Implications: Subclasses specialize in distinct psionic focuses, including Chronopath (time manipulation), Metamorph (body manipulation), Pyrokinetic (flames), and Resopath (reality manipulation).

Name: Warlock
Description: Occultists empowered by pacts with otherworldly entities, trading loyalty for hidden knowledge and modular arcane secrets.
Character Creation Implications: Hit Die: d8. Saves: Wisdom & Charisma. Grants Pact Magic (slots recover on short rest) and modular Eldritch Invocations. Subclass chosen at level 3.

Name: Wizard
Description: Scholarly magic-users who study arcane theory to cast spells of explosive fire, subtle deception, and spectacular transformations.
Character Creation Implications: Hit Die: d6. Saves: Intelligence & Wisdom. Grants an expansive spellbook, Arcane Recovery (regain slots on short rest), and Ritual Casting. Subclass chosen at level 3.
